title: herdr-app-tui touch-first layout
brief: Redesign the mobile TUI around touch targets and a sidebar that keeps its actions, without degrading the desktop rail.

artboards.title: Safe-area sheet
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to today's sheet; two-cell tab rows cost vertical space.

artboards.title: Stacked deck
artboards.tradeoff: Two-line tab rows read clearly at arm's length; one extra row per tab.

artboards.title: Rising peek
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps live output visible while choosing; shorter tab list and a harder zone boundary.
